```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
load("dane/imiona_df.Rda")
imiona <- imiona_df
```




```{r}
skim(imiona)
```

```{r}
imiona %>% 
  filter(rok == 2010, imie == "Anna") %>% 
  group_by(miesiac) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba))
```

```{r}
imiona %>% 
  mutate(litery = paste(str_sub(imie, 1, 1), str_sub(imie, -1, -1), sep = "_"))
```

```{r}
imiona %>% 
  mutate(litery = str_replace(imie, 
                              "^[^AEIOUYaeiouy]*(.).*", 
                              replacement = str_dup("\\1", str_length(imie))
                              )
  )
```

```{r}
moje_dane <- tibble(
  litery = c("A","A","B","C","C"),
  liczby = c(1, 2 , 4, 3, 3)
)
moje_dane %>% distinct(litery)
```

```{r}
# Imie damskie i męskie
imiona %>% 
  distinct(imie, plec) %>% 
  count(imie) %>% 
  filter(n == 2)
```

```{r}
# Imie damskie i męskie - inny sposób
imiona %>% 
  distinct(imie, plec) %>% 
  filter(duplicated(imie))
```

```{r}
library(babynames)
babynames
```

```{r}
babynames %>% 
  distinct(name, sex) %>% 
  count(name) %>% 
  filter(n == 2)
```

```{r}
babynames %>% 
  filter(name == "Raphael", sex == "F") %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(count = sum(n))
```

```{r}
babynames %>% 
  filter(n == max(n))
```

```{r}
rys_wyk_pop <- function(im, kol) {
  imiona %>% 
    filter(imie == im, between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
    group_by(rok) %>% 
    summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = rok, y = ile)) + 
    geom_line(colour = kol, size = 1.2) + 
    geom_point(colour = kol, size = 2.0) +
    labs(title = paste("Popularność imienia", im), x = "", y = "") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2005:2015) + 
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
rys_wyk_pop("Stanisław", "red4")
```

```{r}
wybrane_imiona <- c("Barbara", "Maria", "Stanisław", "Ignacy", "Żyraf")

p <- imiona %>% 
  filter(imie %in% wybrane_imiona, between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
  group_by(rok, imie) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rok, y = ile, colour = imie)) + 
  geom_line(size = 1.2) + 
  geom_point(size = 2.0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2005:2015) + 
  theme_minimal()
p
```

```{r}
library(plotly)
ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}
top10 <- imiona %>%
  group_by(imie) %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(liczba)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(ile)) %>% 
  slice_max(ile, n = 10)

top10 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = ile, y = imie)) + 
  geom_col(fill = "black") +
  theme_minimal()
```
